name: Near North Health
description: A community health center network serving Chicago's South and West Sides with affirming, judgment-free primary and preventive care. A founding LoveWell health partner.

name: Center on Halsted
description: Chicago's LGBTQ+ community center and the fiscal sponsor of Pride South Side, offering programming, social services, and gathering space for the community.

name: Equality Illinois
description: The state's leading LGBTQ+ civil rights organization, advancing policy, education, and community programs across Illinois.

name: Impulse Group Chicago
description: A grassroots collective engaging gay, bi, and queer men of color through health education, HIV testing access, and community events.

name: Project Vida
description: A bilingual, bicultural health and social services organization supporting families and individuals across Chicago's Southeast Side.

name: Taskforce Prevention & Recovery
description: Substance use prevention, treatment, and recovery support services rooted in culturally responsive, community-based care.

name: Human Rights Campaign — Chicago
description: The Chicago chapter of the nation's largest LGBTQ+ civil rights organization, mobilizing local advocacy, fundraising, and community engagement.

name: Center for Black Equity
description: A national network advancing the health, wellness, and economic empowerment of Black LGBTQ+ communities through culture and advocacy.

name: DuSable Black History Museum and Education Center
description: Home of the annual Pride South Side festival, preserving and celebrating Black history, art, and culture on the South Side of Chicago.
